pr_title: module: require.resolve.paths returns null with node schema
pr_body:
require.resolve.paths should returns null with builtin module. when builtin module without `node:` schema, `paths` returns null. But, it don't return null when builtin module with `node:` schema.

Fixes: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/45001

issue_context.title: "node:" prefix
comments:
This confirms an incorrect result as follows:
`console.log(require.resolve.paths("node:url"));`
result:
`[
  'G:\\www\\nodejs\\node_modules',
  'G:\\www\\node_modules',
  'G:\\node_modules']`

review_comments: This is in the CommonJS loader; what about the ESM loader? Does it use this same logic?
This same logic is not used in ESM Loader.
